units.passage: Faculty are required to review instructional materials created by GenAI to ensure the highest quality, accuracy, and appropriateness.
units.why: 'Faculty are required to review instructional materials created by GenAI to ensure the highest quality, accuracy, and appropriateness' is a review duty: P48.

units.passage: If faculty choose to use AI in a substantial way to create, augment, or refine instructional materials, they are strongly encouraged to disclose in a syllabus statement their AI usage.
units.why: Faculty 'are strongly encouraged to disclose in a syllabus statement their AI usage' when AI is used substantially for materials: P48 (disclosure of AI-made materials).
units.fit_note: Also exempts routine grammar assistance, search and autocomplete from disclosure.

units.passage: Routine grammar assistance, search features, or autocomplete do not require disclosure.
units.why: 'Routine grammar assistance, search features, or autocomplete do not require disclosure' sets a threshold under which instructors need not disclose: P48 with a fit note.
units.fit_note: Exempts routine uses from disclosure, which the type does not mention.

units.passage: it is important to ensure that the generated content aligns with your learning objectives, maintains academic integrity, and is reviewed for accuracy, clarity, and bias.
units.why: AI-generated course content must be 'reviewed for accuracy, clarity, and bias', the review half of P48.

units.passage: AI-generated material should serve as a starting point, with human oversight to refine, personalize, and contextualize it for your specific audience.
units.why: 'AI-generated material should serve as a starting point, with human oversight' requires instructor review of AI-made materials (P48).

units.passage: If you choose to use AI for course design, you should be transparent with students by clearly stating that you have done it.
units.why: Instructors using AI for course design 'should be transparent with students', disclosing AI-made materials (P48); P47 covers instructor AI use generally, but this concerns materials.

units.passage: Note: ChatGPT was used to help generate these ideas which have been reviewed and revised by the IST LD team.
units.why: The page discloses that ChatGPT helped generate its content and that staff 'reviewed and revised' it, an example of the disclose-and-review practice (P48).

units.passage: As with any AI use, make sure you review and revise the outputs so that they are accurate and unbiased.
units.why: 'Review and revise the outputs so that they are accurate and unbiased' repeats the review rule for AI-made assessments (P48).

units.passage: First, as an instructor, you must be willing to be honest and open about any GenAI output that appears in course materials.
units.why: 'You must be willing to be honest and open about any GenAI output that appears in course materials' requires disclosing AI-made materials (P48).

units.passage: Final grades and substantive evaluative judgments remain the responsibility of the instructor, and human review is required before AI-assisted content is shared with students.
units.why: "human review is required before AI-assisted content is shared with students" sets a condition on AI-assisted feedback, P101.
units.fit_note: Covers any AI-assisted content shared with students, including feedback, not only course materials.

units.passage: For educational materials, note in slide footers or syllabi if AI assisted in generating content or images.

units.policy: Faculty who develop instructional resources using AI and build assignments anchored in AI shall acknowledge attribution.
units.why: "Faculty who develop instructional resources using AI ... shall acknowledge attribution" requires instructors to disclose AI-made course materials, P48, must.

units.passage: It’s on us to check lecture notes or rubrics for fairness before sharing them
units.why: Faculty check "lecture notes or rubrics for fairness before sharing" them, a review duty for AI-made materials (P48).

units.why: "it is crucial that you retain human oversight and adjust based on your subject matter expertise" requires instructor review of AI-made materials: P48.

units.why: The report says it is 'important to validate any questions assigned to students for accuracy and appropriateness'. Instructors review AI-made materials, so P48.

units.why: The report recommends instructors 'follow the guidelines of attribution if they choose to use GAI to produce course materials'. Disclosure of AI-made materials, so P48.

units.why: The page says 'if instructors choose to use LLMs to help in the preparation of course materials, such work should be acknowledged and attributed'. Disclosure of AI-made materials, so P48.

units.passage: Generative artiﬁcial intelligence technologies were utilized to assist in the research, drafting, and organization of this policy document. units.why: The document states AI was used 'to assist in the research, drafting, and organization' and reviewed by staff: disclosure of AI-made materials, P48.

units.passage: University personnel carefully reviewed and validated all generative AI content to ensure accuracy, relevance, and compliance with institutional values and policies.
units.why: The guidance discloses that 'Generative artificial intelligence technologies were utilized to assist in the research, drafting' and that personnel 'carefully reviewed and validated' the content; AI-made institutional material disclosed and reviewed (P48).

units.passage: Be sure to test the prompts before you share them with students and pass along the cautions outlined above.
units.why: "Be sure to test the prompts before you share them with students" asks instructors to review AI-made materials before sharing, P48.

units.passage: Review AI-generated content for accuracy, bias, and appropriateness before sharing it with students.
units.why: "Review AI-generated content for accuracy, bias, and appropriateness before sharing it with students" requires review of AI-made materials; P48.

units.passage: If possible, periodically check with fluent speakers to see if these translations are accurate.

units.passage: However, it is important to verify, fact check, asses for bias, any material generated or revised using AI.

units.why: Instructors are 'strongly encouraged to disclose in a syllabus statement their AI usage' when they use AI substantially for materials. Disclosure of AI-made materials fits P48 (disclosed and reviewed materials).
